derivation: contract C2 `hreflang_nonreciprocal` over a complete three-page graph: every internal target returns the same tag; each page lists itself and resolves canonical to self.

<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://gamma.example/c">
</head><body></body></html>
